work.description: DCCLIV: full Consuevit apostolica Sedes eight-clause brief, complete municipal history/papally granted privileges, territorial/institutional description, restoration/concession with episcopal/governmental jurisdiction unchanged, legal clauses and complete datum LF53396–53401. XML leaves398–400 normal substantive L/R with no wide joins. Historical loss of old municipal records described at LF53100ff does not mean present-witness omission; no current fragment. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
